info.title: ERP Integration API
info.description: API for managing ERP system integrations, including connector management, data synchronization, and order processing.

get.description: Retrieve a list of all registered ERP connectors with their status

post.description: Register and configure a new ERP system connector (deprecated - use AddConnector instead)
Create a new ERP connector with secure credential storage (Odoo, Dynamics365, NetSuite, SAP, ERPNext, Frappe)

delete.description: Remove an ERP connector and its associated data. Use force option to remove even with active syncs

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Force removal even if there are active syncs

put.description: Update an existing ERP connector configuration including credentials, sync settings, and rate limits

post.description: Update inventory reservations for order fulfillment - Use granular commands instead
Send an order to the connected ERP system for processing

get.description: Retrieve detailed status information for a specific ERP connector
Retrieve synchronization history for a specific connector

post.description: Trigger a manual synchronization of customers from the ERP system
Trigger a manual synchronization of product prices from the ERP system
Trigger a manual synchronization of products from the ERP system
Trigger a manual synchronization of stock levels from the ERP system
Toggle a connector between active and inactive states. Inactive connectors do not process syncs or webhooks
Create a new inventory reservation for an order
Mark a reservation as fulfilled (items shipped)
Release/cancel an existing inventory reservation
Transfer a reservation to another warehouse location
Create a new invoice in the system
Approve a pending invoice for processing
Record a payment against an invoice
Send an invoice to customer via email or other method
Void an existing invoice with reason
Create a new return merchandise authorization (RMA)
Approve a pending return request
Mark a return as completed after refund processing
Start processing an approved return
Reject a return request with reason
Record items restocked to inventory from a return

activate.title: true to activate, false to deactivate

The JSON representation for `NullValue` is JSON `null`.
